name: TryAMM Black Business Directory
purpose: Verified discovery, commerce, growth, and diaspora/Africa connection layer for Black-owned businesses within the broader inclusive TryAMM marketplace.
principles: Verification must be evidence-based and auditable.
The directory is an affinity/discovery layer inside a broader platform open to all eligible businesses.
Directory inclusion must not imply government certification unless actually verified.

Businesses can opt into storefront, restaurant, services, HoloMenu, HoloCoupons, HoloAds, creator affiliate campaigns, HoloLocal, Ride/Delivery, HoloTV commerce, and Africa/diaspora commerce where available.
